notes.title: Patch 1.1: 2017 update!
notes.content:
Merry Christmas!

We've updated Santa Sling with performance improvements, more toys, UI and sound effect overhauls, and more! We hope you enjoy!

1.1

	 Bug Fixes:
	
		 Fixed the game being unable to progress sometimes after failing level 3
		 Substantially improved FPS in levels 2 & 3
                 Fixed Santa disappearing sometimes
                 Fixed play area orientation so it matches the player's set area
                 Fixed Santa's animation not looping
	
	 Additions:
	
		 4 new toys: Nutcracker, Yo-yo, Wagon, and Rynn Plushie
                 UI has been completely overhauled so it's cleaner, easier to interact with, and clearer
                 Sound effects have been updated and new sound effects have been added
                 The fireworks effect has been updated to have more fireworks and a toy-specific firework at the end
